Name: Mumbai Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Bandra West, Malad West, and Thane West are prime. High suburban density in Thane drives growth.
Blind_Spots__c: High competition from 50+ organized stores. Extreme real estate costs and low rental yields.

Name: Pune Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Kalyani Nagar, Hinjewadi, and Hadapsar are top sites. High student and IT workforce population.
Blind_Spots__c: Infrastructure bottlenecks and traffic congestion near Hinjewadi IT parks.

Name: Bangalore Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Indiranagar, HSR Layout, and Whitefield are premier. Highest FMCG spend per kg in India.
Blind_Spots__c: Quick commerce dominance is extremely high. Talent attrition in retail staff is a risk.

Name: Hyderabad Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Gachibowli, Banjara Hills, and Jubilee Hills are core. Strong pharma and IT middle-class base.
Blind_Spots__c: Fragmented local competition from regional chains like Ratnadeep.

Name: Delhi Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Vasant Kunj, Rohini, and Dwarka are key. Highest FMCG spend per household in West Delhi.
Blind_Spots__c: Over-saturation of shopping malls. Regulatory vigilance regarding heritage zones.

Name: Chennai Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: T. Nagar, Adyar, and Velachery are top performing. Stable, brand-loyal consumer base.
Blind_Spots__c: Complex labor union dynamics. Strong preference for traditional trade in some pockets.

Name: Ahmedabad Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: CG Road, Prahlad Nagar, and Satellite. Deep quality-seeking population.
Blind_Spots__c: Informal trade dominance. Resistance to premium pricing without clear utility.

Name: Gandhinagar Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Sargasan, Kudasan, and GIFT City zones. Elite tech-savvy workforce base.
Blind_Spots__c: Limited night-time footfall. Lower population density compared to Ahmedabad.

Name: Surat Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Adajan, Vesu, and Piplod are prime. High disposable income from diamond industry.
Blind_Spots__c: Lack of Grade A mall space in central areas. Heavy seasonal festive demand.

Name: Vadodara Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Alkapuri, Gotri Road, and Manjalpur. Stable industrial employee base.
Blind_Spots__c: Proximity to Ahmedabad leads to retail leakage. High demand for value formats.

Name: Bhopal Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Arera Colony, Ayodhya Nagar, and Kolar Road. Administrative and educational center.
Blind_Spots__c: Low adoption of premium D2C brands. High dominance of neighborhood kiranas.

Name: Indore Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Vijay Nagar, Rajendra Nagar, and Nipania. Commercial hub with high aspirational demand.
Blind_Spots__c: Increasing rental rates in prime junctions. Intense price wars among existing hypermarkets.

Name: Gwalior Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: City Centre, DD Nagar, and Morar. Latent demand for modern organized grocery.
Blind_Spots__c: Low income levels in outskirts. Dominance of traditional wholesale markets.

Name: Jabalpur Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Civil Lines, Vijay Nagar, and Napier Town. Government and defense population base.
Blind_Spots__c: Logistics challenges for fresh produce. Lack of organized retail warehousing.

Name: Lucknow Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Gomti Nagar, Hazratganj, and Alambagh are elite. Strong growth in mall culture.
Blind_Spots__c: Traffic congestion in old city areas. Rapid but uneven urbanization.

Name: Kanpur Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Mall Road, Kakadeo, and Swarup Nagar. Industrial base with huge population density.
Blind_Spots__c: Severe infrastructure decay. Competition from unorganized wholesale markets.

Name: Agra Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Sanjay Place, Sadar Bazaar, and Fatehabad Road. Tourism-driven local demand.
Blind_Spots__c: Seasonal demand volatility. Heritage-zone construction regulations.

Name: Varanasi Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Sigra, Orderly Bazar, and Lanka. Pilgrimage-driven floating population.
Blind_Spots__c: Narrow road infrastructure. High cost of land in central transit hubs.

Name: Noida Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Sector 18, Sector 62, and Sector 137. High-income residential hub.
Blind_Spots__c: Dependency on weekend footfall. Strong competition from Delhi-based malls.

Name: Jaipur Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Mansarovar, Malviya Nagar, and Vaishali Nagar. Education sector drives demand.
Blind_Spots__c: Water scarcity issues affecting large-scale cooling operations.

Name: Jodhpur Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Sardarpura, Ratanada, and Shastri Nagar. Rising modern aspirations.
Blind_Spots__c: Slow corporate investment pace. Strong preference for local dairy brands.

Name: Udaipur Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Sukhadia Circle, Madhuban, and Sector 11. Luxury and tourism retail hub.
Blind_Spots__c: Geography limits large-format development. Price-sensitive local consumer base.

Name: Kota Market Analysis
Top_Sites__c: Talwandi, Kunadi, and Vigyan Nagar. Captive student population.
Blind_Spots__c: Cyclical demand based on coaching seasons. Low potential for luxury segment.
